text: 58M with HTN and DM2 presenting with 2 hours of substernal chest pressure with diaphoresis. Differential includes ACS, aortic dissection, PE. Ordered CBC, BMP, troponin x2, chest x-ray. My interpretation of the ECG: sinus rhythm, 1 mm ST depressions V4-V6. Troponin 0.08 then 0.21. Started heparin drip. Discussed with Dr. Lee (cardiology), who agrees with NSTEMI management. Admitted to step-down.

24F inverted right ankle playing basketball. Tender over ATFL, no bony tenderness at malleoli or base of 5th metatarsal, ambulatory. Ottawa negative, no imaging indicated. Ankle sprain. RICE, ibuprofen as needed, ankle brace, follow up with PCP if not improving in a week.

31F with 2 days of dysuria and frequency, no fever, no flank pain, not pregnant per patient. UA with positive leukocyte esterase and nitrites. Acute uncomplicated cystitis. Prescribed nitrofurantoin 100 mg BID x5 days. Return precautions for fever or flank pain.

45M with 12 hours of epigastric pain and nausea, no prior episodes. Differential includes pancreatitis, biliary colic, PUD, early appendicitis. Ordered CBC, CMP, lipase, urinalysis. Labs unremarkable, lipase normal. Pain improved after IV ondansetron and famotidine. Abdomen soft and nontender on reassessment. Discharged with ondansetron prescription and PCP follow-up in 2 days.
